entry.name: jit.dx.grab
entry.description: Digitizes video from any DirectX-compatible video digitizer, and decompresses the signal into a Jitter matrix. It also offers a grab-to-disk mode. Although numerous parameters for control are offered, not all features are supported by all digitizers.

This attribute helps distinguish between devices with the same name in systems with multiple video devices. The ID remains consistent across application launches and system reboots.

messages.name: close
messages.description: Closes an open sequence grab component. The component is automatically closed when the object is freed.

messages.name: exportimage
messages.digest: Export the current frame as an image file
messages.description: Export the current frame as an image file with the name specified by the first argument. The second argument sets the file type (default = png). Available file types are,, and.You can use the Max Preferences tofor png image types.

messages.name: getformatlist
messages.description: Reports the list of available digitizer formats from the object's right outlet, preceded by the word. Note that the digitizer must bein order for this method to function.

messages.name: getinputlist
messages.description: Reports the list of available inputs to the video digitizer from the object's right outlet, preceded by the word. Note that the digitizer must bein order for this method to function.

messages.name: getsnddevlist
messages.description: Reports the list of available sound digitizers from the object's right outlet, preceded by the word.

messages.name: getsndinputlist
messages.description: Reports the list of available inputs for the current sound digitizer from the object's right outlet, preceded by the word. Note that the digitizer must bein order for this method to function.

messages.name: getvdevlist
messages.description: Reports the list of available video digitizers from the object's right outlet, preceded by the word.

messages.name: open
messages.description: Opens a sequence grab component. A component must be explicitly opened before theobject will began digitizing.

messages.name: settings
messages.description: Opens the standard video digitizer settings dialog box.

messages.name: snd_settings
messages.description: Opens the standard sound digitizer settings dialog box.

messages.name: write
messages.description: Starts grabbing to disk. If noargument is supplied, a file dialog box will open. The defaultis 30. frames/sec.
